summary: The main article describes a photoredox-catalyzed method for adding carbamoyl radicals to olefins using 4-carboxamido-Hantzsch esters. It includes optimization tables, substrate scope schemes, and mechanistic studies including fluorescence quenching and light on/off experiments.
